context: Tests the primary happy path and the report format, including a removed API version, a wrong field type and policy gaps that only a policy checker finds.

checklist.name: Runs the stages in order
checklist.description: Runs or follows the tool check, yamllint with the repository config, CRD detection, kubeconform and a dry-run, in that order

checklist.name: Collects before reporting
checklist.description: Continues through all stages and reports all issues together, not just the first

checklist.name: Removed API version
checklist.description: Flags extensions/v1beta1 as a problem to fix and gives apps/v1 as the fix, and does not wave it off as a minor warning

checklist.name: Wrong field type
checklist.description: Flags containerPort "80" as a string where an integer is required

checklist.name: File and line
checklist.description: Gives file:line references for the issues

checklist.name: Before and after
checklist.description: Shows a before and after code block for each issue

checklist.name: Severity table
checklist.description: Gives a summary table classifying issues as Error, Warning or Info

checklist.name: Targets the cluster version
checklist.description: Validates against Kubernetes 1.28 using kubeconform -kubernetes-version or a server-side dry-run

checklist.name: Policy checker
checklist.description: Runs or recommends a policy checker such as Polaris or kube-score and flags the latest tag and missing limits and probes

checklist.name: Report only
checklist.description: Does not modify deployment.yaml and does not offer to apply the fixes

checklist.name: Summary and next steps
checklist.description: Ends with a stage status table and next steps
